subject: NeoAI budget sensitivity & accelerator credit request
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Singh <aisha@neoai.dev>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-22T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap: token profile + budget sensitivity (NeoAI)

Aisha — thanks again for a productive call earlier. Quick written recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned while you loop in procurement. Key takeaways I captured: 

- Primary workload: customer-facing summarization + short-form personalization. Typical prompt lengths 300-800 tokens; expected avg response ~450 tokens.
- Expected traffic: pilot months 1–3 ~3–6M tokens/month; scale target months 6–12 ~12–25M tokens/month depending on feature adoption.
- Budget posture: tight for Q2 pilot; leadership ok with experimenting if we can show clear $/1M token path and a startup accelerator credit to offset initial consumption.
- Compliance: standard SOC2 + IP provisions acceptable; they will share procurement contact.

Attached I dropped a quick pricing workbook with three scenarios (pilot, scale, and commit). High-level candidate unit economics we discussed: target $/1M tokens in the range of $900–$1,400 depending on committed volume and multi-year term.

Proposed commercial path (suggested):
1) 6 month pilot with a small committed token block (e.g., 60M tokens over 6 months) + startup accelerator credit applied to first invoice.
2) If we hit the midpilot adoption signal (>=10M tokens/mo), convert to a 12 month committed plan with stepped volume bands and a multi-year incentive (additional 10% rebate year 2).

Action items / next steps:
- Aisha: confirm procurement contact and whether NeoAI can share a PDF of the standard PO flow.
- Nikhil & Marissa: prepare 1-page commercial summary + redlineable SOW (attached draft) and a capped accelerator credit proposal.
- Ben: reserve discount approval range for quick turn.

If the budget ceiling is lower than the scenarios in the workbook, tell us the monthly cap you need and we’ll build a tailored commit band to hit your target $/1M token.

Thanks — will stand by for procurement contact.

—Nikhil
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
nikhil@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0187

Attachments: neoai_pricing_workbook_q1_2027.xlsx (pricing bands), proposed_mau_commit_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW draft)

From: Aisha Singh <aisha@neoai.dev>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@neoai.dev>
Date: 2027-03-22T17:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: token profile + budget sensitivity (NeoAI)

Thanks, Nikhil — this is helpful and matches our internal notes. A few clarifications from my side: 

1) Pilot budget: we have $20k–$25k budgeted for the pilot period (3 months) which needs to cover both API spend and some initial infra/observability work.
2) Token estimate: conservative plan for pilot is 4M tokens/month; optimistic is 9–10M/month if feature uptake is quick.
3) Accelerator ask: we run through an accelerator program at NeoAI (seed-backed) — would you be able to provide a one-time credit (preferably $8k–$12k) toward the pilot invoice? That helps us get the pilot approved.
4) Discount ask: for a 12-month committed plan (12M tokens/mo minimum), we’d be targeting a landed cost near $1,000 per 1M tokens. Is that in scope with Redwood’s committed bands?

Looping in our procurement team on Cc to confirm PO flow and required contract terms. Procurement — can you share the standard PO template and whether net-30 is acceptable?

Aisha Singh
Head of Product, NeoAI
aisha@neoai.dev

On Tue, Mar 22, 2027 at 3:10 PM Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai> wrote: > (post-call recap)

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Singh <aisha@neoai.dev>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-23T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: token profile + budget sensitivity (NeoAI)

Appreciate the clarity, Aisha — and thanks for pulling procurement in. Quick responses inline and a concrete starter proposal below so your team can review: 

- Pilot credit: we can offer a one-time accelerator credit of $10,000 applied to the first invoice. That lands squarely in the range you requested and is approvable under our seed/startup program.
- Pilot commercial: 3-month pilot priced at list with credit applied; we’ll include a capped token consumption clause in the SOW so you don’t exceed the pilot budget unexpectedly. For your conservative estimate (4M tokens/mo) the net spend after credit would be roughly $-- see scenarios below.
- Committed bands: for a 12-month commit at >=12M tokens/mo we can offer unit pricing in the $950–$1,050 per 1M token band depending on whether you take the Reserved (dedicated) option vs hosted. If you choose a 24-month ramp + year-2 rebate we can reduce effective $/1M further (up to additional 8–12% depending on sizing).

Example scenarios (illustrative numbers):
A) Pilot conservative — 3 months x 4M tokens/mo = 12M tokens total. List cost @ $1,300/1M = $15,600. Accelerator credit $10,000 => first invoice $5,600 (plus small infra services line item).
B) Pilot optimistic — 3 months x 9M tokens/mo = 27M tokens total. List cost @ $1,200/1M = $32,400. Accelerator credit $10,000 => first invoice $22,400. We’d include alerts and a cap so you can pause consumption before the credit is exhausted.
C) Committed 12-month — 12M tokens/mo (144M/yr). With committed discount our proposed starting band is $995/1M (hosted). If you opt for Redwood Dedicated and commit to a 24-month window, effective $/1M could go sub-$900 after year-2 rebate.

Next concrete items from us this week:
- Updated 1-page commercial summary that shows the math for A/B above + capped SOW language (I’ll attach v1).
- A clean DocuSign-ready SOW and a single-line pricing sheet for procurement.

Marissa will follow up with final approved discount ranges for the signing authority. Ben — flag if we need leadership approval for the accelerator credit or the deeper multi-year band.

If that looks reasonable we’ll prepare a short commercial proposal and a redlineable SOW for your procurement team to review.

—Nikhil

Thanks all — quick internal note and next steps from Redwood’s side.

- Accelerator credit of $10k approved for NeoAI (one-time, applied to first invoice).
- Approver note: Nikhil and Marissa can sign commercial proposal up to $15k in total discounts; anything beyond that scope requires VP approval.
- We’ll produce two documents for procurement: 1) single-line pricing PDF with committed band options, 2) redline-friendly SOW including capped pilot consumption and cancellation language. I’ll start the DocuSign envelope once procurement confirms PO terms.

Aisha — if 3rd-party PO flow is required, share your PO template and we’ll confirm net-30 vs net-45. Also cc the legal contact if you expect any non-standard data clauses.

Action owners: 
- Nikhil: send updated commercial summary + pricing PDF to procurement by end of day 3/24.
- Marissa: confirm allowable discount collar for a 24-month commitment (target band and minimum MAU).
- Ben: create DocuSign envelope placeholder and attach SOW v1.

Thanks — we want you to be able to start the pilot with confidence.

Ben Carter
